report.clinical_summary: Patient has been living with HIV for over 10 years and has been on Tivicay and Descovy once daily for about 2 years. They're experiencing persistent, intense headaches that started about 6 months after starting this regimen. The headaches are affecting their ability to concentrate at work and enjoy time with family. The illness has impacted their work (requiring time off), relationships (difficulty maintaining them), and daily functioning (some days they can barely get out of bed). They've educated themselves about HIV over the years and become an advocate for others, but still feel the illness dominates their life. They're balancing the necessity of the medication with concerns about side effects and are open to adjusting their treatment.
